speaker_role: law school admissions dean (Dean Z, Michigan Law), per channel and context
key_insights: Law-school video: says a why-school essay will not hurt financial aid, dismissing the rumor that showing love for a school hurts aid.
Personal ties to the area, such as family or a job, are acceptable reasons.
Avoid generic statements that could apply to many schools, and avoid leaning on a single professor.
Specific reasons and examples make the essay more persuasive; if you lack specifics, choose another prompt if available.
notable_or_distinctive: Directly rebuts an online myth about why-X essays and financial aid, for law school.
reliability_notes: Graduate law school context, not undergraduate; speaker admits he cannot speak for all financial aid offices.
